scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --parallel --filter frontend --filter backend build
scripts.deploy:backend: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @curated-labs/backend db:generate && pnpm --filter @curated-labs/backend build
scripts.deploy:frontend: pnpm install && pnpm --filter @curated-labs/shared build && pnpm --filter frontend build
